newsitem.title: THAILAND: Hong Kong to buy 270,000-tonne Thai rice in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong to buy 270,000-tonne Thai rice in 1997.

text.p: Hong Kong rice traders on Friday signed a memorandum of understanding to import 270,000 tonnes of top-grade Thai fragrant rice in 1997 against 265,000 tonnes expected to be lifted this year, Thai Commerce Minister Chucheep Hansawat said.
Chucheep said Hong Kong rice buyers would hold quarterly negotiations on the price of the Thai rice they plan to buy next year.
The minister said members of the Thai Rice Exporters Association would offer discounts to Hong Kong buyers who fully utilised Thai rice import quotas allocated to them next year.
Chucheep said he expected Thai rice exports this year to exceed an earlier government target of 5.2 million tonnes against 6.23 million in 1995.
He said Thailand shipped out more than four million tonnes during January/September against about 4.71 million a year ago.
